name: The Rejected: Many-Handed Crawler
senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius); passive Perception 11
languages: Understands Common; speaks only through Mimicry.
bio: Someone Must Hurt: user-supplied homebrew for five 8th-level characters using 2014 rules. CR 5 is the source's design estimate, not a playtest result. This is the grasping, coiled Rejected portrait. Seize a character, then bite the held target while the partner attacks exposed adventurers. A creature held 10 feet away is beyond Bone Beak's 5-foot reach: move or drag it closer before biting. Mimicry is a horror cue, not proof of a genuine alternate timeline. This is distinct from the Spinal Crawler; do not substitute an ordinary grick.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Climbs difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: Can imitate short phrases and other sounds it has heard. A listener recognizes the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Makes two Grasping Hand attacks and one Bone Beak attack. Bone Beak requires the target to be within 5 feet.

actions.name: Grasping Hand
actions.description: Average hit damage 11. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the crawler can grapple it (escape DC 15). The grappled target is restrained until this grapple ends. The crawler can grapple only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Bone Beak
actions.description: Average hit damage 13. A target grappled 10 feet away is outside this attack's reach.
